data.name: Adjust search keywords or clear the search to view all apps.
data.value: 调整搜索关键词或清除搜索条件以查看所有应用。

data.name: App ID, historical incident records, push channel bindings, and enable/disable status remain unchanged.
data.value: 应用 ID、历史事件记录、推送渠道绑定以及启用/禁用状态均保持不变。

data.name: Application Access Credentials (API Key)
data.value: 应用访问凭据（API 密钥）

data.name: Confirm app and all data deletion
data.value: 确认删除应用及其所有数据

data.name: Create a business app above and issue a dedicated API Key.
data.value: 请在上方创建一个业务应用，并为其签发专用 API 密钥。

data.name: Credentials are displayed only once after this operation. The original key cannot be viewed again after refreshing or leaving this page.
data.value: 操作完成后，凭据仅显示一次。刷新或离开此页面后，将无法再次查看原始密钥。

data.name: Distribute independent API credentials for business services and manage reporting permissions and push routing.
data.value: 为业务服务分配独立的 API 凭据，并管理报告权限和推送路由。

data.name: Enter the app name to confirm deletion:
data.value: 请输入应用名称以确认删除：

data.name: Example: Order payment service, User Center, Edge Gateway…
data.value: 示例：订单支付服务、用户中心、边缘网关……

data.name: No matching applications found
data.value: 未找到匹配的应用程序

data.name: On-call group is optional; if bound, the on-duty engineer is automatically notified by email, and the on-call group configuration address is CC'd. Custom push channels can still be configured independently.
data.value: 值班组为可选项；绑定后，系统会自动通过电子邮件通知当班工程师，并抄送值班组配置的地址。自定义推送渠道仍可单独配置。

data.name: Please store the key securely in environment variables or a key service.
data.value: 请将密钥安全地存储在环境变量或密钥服务中。

data.name: The name must match exactly (case-sensitive).
data.value: 名称必须完全匹配（区分大小写）。

data.name: The old key has been invalidated immediately. All reporting clients must be updated. The new key is displayed only once; please save it now.
data.value: 旧密钥已立即失效。所有报告客户端都必须更新。新密钥仅显示一次，请立即保存。

data.name: The old key will become invalid immediately. All reporting clients must be updated. The new key is displayed only once on this page.
data.value: 旧密钥将立即失效。所有上报客户端都必须更新。新密钥仅在此页面显示一次。

data.name: This action is irreversible! All historical incidents, associated delivery records, and in-site notifications for this application will be deleted, and all API keys will be immediately invalidated.
data.value: 此操作不可逆！该应用的所有历史事件、相关交付记录以及站内通知都将被删除，所有 API 密钥将立即失效。

data.name: This action is irreversible! All historical incidents, associated delivery records, and in-site notifications for this application will be deleted, and the API Key will be immediately invalidated.
data.value: 此操作不可撤销！此应用的所有历史事件、相关投递记录和站内通知都将被删除，API 密钥也将立即失效。

data.name: Use a concise and clear business system name; the system will automatically generate the corresponding prefix ID and random Secret.
data.value: 请使用简洁明了的业务系统名称；系统将自动生成对应的前缀 ID 和随机 Secret。

data.name: Use a concise business system name. Create its API keys separately after creating the application.
data.value: 请使用简洁的业务系统名称。创建应用后，请单独创建其 API 密钥。

data.name: View integration guide to send the first test message
data.value: 查看集成指南，发送第一条测试消息
